hero.title: Firebolt 8 Core API Specification
hero.description: Standardized APIs that give RDK8 applications consistent access to device and platform capabilities through Firebolt.

api-0.overview: Returns the audio description setting of the device

items: list of one or more ISO 639-2/B

api-1.overview: Returns captions settings: enabled, and a list of zero or more languages in order of decreasing preference

api-2.overview: Returns the high contrast UI device setting

api-3.overview: Returns voice guidance settings: enabled, rate, and verbosity

api-5.overview: Returns a persistent unique UUID for the current app and device. The UUID is reset when the app or device is reset

api-6.overview: Returns the HDR standards that are suported by the attached TV or the integral display

items: OTT/STB device: supported by the device and indicated by the EDID of the attached TV
watchedOn - ISO 8601 date and time in UTC - optional

api-7.overview: Notify the platform that content has been partially or completely watched

trailing.body: progress: VOD: 0 to 0.99, live: number of seconds

api-8.overview: Request the platform to deactivate the app, and possibly take further actiontype

items: deactivate - app is deactivated (if active) - typically a user closing an app
unload - app is deactivated (if active) and terminated - typically an app has detected an error
killReload - app is killed, then reloaded to paused or suspended (by policy)
killReactivate - app is killed, reloaded, then activated

trailing.body: Module is named Lifecycle in C++ Client Library

api-9.overview: Returns the current lifecycle state of the app. The first lifecycle state that can be observed by an app/runtime is the initializing state

trailing.body: Apps/runtimes should ordinarily use state change notifications rather than this method

items: change - list of one lifecycle state change

api-10.overview: Subscribe to/unsubscribe from lifecycle state changes. The app/runtime remains in the initializing state until the subscribe call is made to the platform

trailing.body: Notification of lifecycle state change, raised after the platform has transitioned the app /runtime to the new lifecycle state
Note: the list always carries exactly one lifecycle state change

items: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (see Country in Devices table)

api-11.overview: Return the country, e.g. US, CA, GB, BE

items: list of one or more ISO 639-2/B (see Secondary Audio Language in Devices table)

api-12.overview: A list of zero or more languages in order of decreasing preference. Typically two languages are present. A language may be repeated in the list

items: BCP 47 (see Presentation Languages in Devices table)

api-13.overview: The presentation language of the device, e.g. en-US

api-14.overview: Inform the platform that the app is minimally usable. This method is called automatically by Lifecycle.ready()

api-15.overview: Log a sign in event, called by Discovery. signIn()

api-16.overview: Log a sign out event, called by Discovery. signOut()

api-17.overview: Inform the platform that your user has started content

api-18.overview: Inform the platform that your user has stopped content

api-19.overview: Inform the platform that your user has navigated to a page or view

api-20.overview: Inform the platform of an error that has occurred in your app

api-21.overview: Called when setting the URL of a media asset to play, in order to infer load time

api-22.overview: Called when media playback should start due to autoplay, user-initiated play, or unpausing

api-23.overview: Called when media playback actually starts due to autoplay, user-initiated play, unpausing, or recovering from a buffering interruption

api-24.overview: Called when media playback will pause due to an intentional pause operation

api-25.overview: Called when media playback will halt due to a network, buffer, or other unintentional constraint

api-26.overview: Called when a seek is initiated during media playback

api-27.overview: Called when a seek is completed during media playback

api-28.overview: Called when the playback rate of media is changed

api-29.overview: Called when the playback rendition (e.g. bitrate, dimensions, profile, etc) is changed

api-30.overview: Called when playback has stopped because the end of the media was reached

api-31.overview: Inform the platform of 1st party distributor metrics data parameter is a JSON document

api-32.overview: Inform the platform about an app's build info

api-33.overview: Returns whether the device has a useable network connection

api-34.overview: Whether the app is in focus, i.e. receiving key presses. Provided for those apps/runtimes that cannot use Wayland

api-35.overview: Speak the utterance immediately. Any ongoing speech is interrupted

trailing.body: Text argument is either plain text or a well- formed SSML document
TTS_Status, not success attribute, to be used by caller to indicate success of call
0 OK, 1 Fail, 2 not enabled, 3 invalid configuration
Raises onSpeechinterrupted if speaking is interrupted

trailing.bdody: Raises onSpeechpause if ongoing speech is paused

trailing.body: Does nothing if utterance is already paused
Raises onSpeechresume if paused speech is resumed Does nothing if the utterance is not paused

api-38.overview: Stop speaking if utterance is currently being spoken Raises onSpeechinterrupted if speaking was interrupted

api-39.overview: Returns the state of the utterance

api-40.overview: Text to speech conversion is about to start

api-41.overview: Utterance is about to be spoken

api-45.overview: Speech was stopped, due to another call to speak or cancel

items: voices - list of one or more strings

api-48.overview: Returns the list of available voices as human- readable strings, e.g. "ava", "amelie", "angelica"

rows.description: A non-mandatory method that is not implemented on this device

rows.description: The app is not in an appropriate lifecycle state to call this method
